reason: Smallest-algebraic mass-metric call is incomplete after cost stop. Critical tangent singularity is associated with zero; fixed zero-target extraction is not a shift chosen to fit force peaks. No more spectral retries in this scope.
subspace: Same fixed N8 periodic Q2 space, same pin and complete original Gauss/material domain.
equation: Kr v=lambda Mr v; Kr is reused original full-domain Ritz matrix, Mr=P^T diag(actual HRZ periodic mass) P, all three components and same pinned class.
meaning: lambda has inverse-second-squared units for the entry normalization. No mass relumping or forward-model change.
solver: One fixed sigma=0 shift-invert generalized eigsh, k=6 ncv=60 tol=1e-8 maxiter=400; same Kr/Mr. Extract closest-to-zero directions, not smallest algebraic/global minimum.
checks: positive mass diagonal/full rank embedding, deterministic quadratic checks
M orthonormality and generalized eigen residual
mechanical full-domain selected mode curvature agrees with Kr
surface/void motion and shell finite event increment patterns
positive_mode_limit: No static base equilibrium or full-space stability certification. A positive minimum in this restricted space cannot rule out fine-space instability.
negative_mode_limit: Record sign and material participation; does not uniquely identify shell/JAX cause or imply dynamic growth history.
cost_rule: Uses remaining time of the single CUDA recovery scope; no new budget reset, no new forward, Abaqus or design AD.
